why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 1.24% and CTR rose 1.90%, while Abandonment Rate rose 2.20%: more searches get a click, but more also end with none.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Abandonment Rate rose 1.55% on head queries and fell 0.38% on tail queries; the tail drop is too small to trust, so the harm may sit in head queries.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Why the new ranker lifts clicks yet also lifts abandonment is unknown; no per-query data was provided.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Abandonment Rate back inside its 1.00% margin on a rerun, for example after a fix to head-query ranking, would reopen the call.
A registered explanation that the Abandonment Rate definition changed between arms would send this to triage.
